name: Side Quest
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Hoshiko Shiro: Untold Protagonist, Uprising's Anarch identity, which flips after a turn with an access and pays a card and a credit a turn while flipped, and the Anarch cards of Uprising Stage 2. On Pay As You Go's frame, its identity swapped: two Mystic Maemi and two Paladin Poemu for its two Take a Dive and two Time Bomb, companions that bank a credit a turn for events and for installs and cost a card at three; two Keiko for its two Friend of a Friend, a console that pays a credit the first time each turn a companion is installed or paid from (and trashes The Toolbox, the older console, by the console limit); two Odore for its two Chastushka, a killer that breaks for nothing beside three virtual resources; and a DreamNet for one Valentina Ferreira Carvalho, a draw on the turn's first successful run. Pay As You Go keeps every card given up here. Uprising Stage 3: a Devil Charm for its Valentina Ferreira Carvalho, −6 strength for a run at the cost of the chip. Uprising Stage 6: two Gachapon for Running Hot, a set-aside install from the top of the stack. Downfall Stage 3: two Fencer Fueno for two Crash Space and two Trickster Taka for two Finality, companions that bank a credit a turn, spend it once a run is successful or on programs during runs, and cost a credit or a tag at three. Reprints Stage 1b: two Lucky Find for two Chain Reaction, which Pay As You Go and Burn Rate still carry.
